Here's how you can translate and breakdown the phrase in English sentence by Chinese grammar rules. The subject (S) is "the color" or 这个颜色，which could be translated as this one: "This color" in Mandarin Chinese translates to "这个" and "of the car" becomes "汽车的".

1. This sentence can't have multiple verbs or actions, so we know that the structure is simple subject-verb (is) - object format.
- The predicate (predicate): 是 (is). It indicates an attribute/quality of the car's color which equates to "is" in English. In Mandarin Chinese it translates as: 翻译为.

The translated sentence would then read as follows: 这个颜色 (this one) is blue or 这个颜色是蓝色的, which translates to "This color" in Mandarin Chinese. The subject-predicate structure can be seen here: 翻译为。
